info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Reminders-v3-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Reminder Retrieval API provides a streamlined method for accessing utility billing reminders for consumers. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of reminders related to their utility bills, aiding in timely payments and service continuity. Typical users include customers and utility service providers looking to manage reminders efficiently. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their billing processes and improve customer engagement through automated notifications.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch reminders related to upcoming billing cycles. It provides necessary details for users to stay informed about their billing schedules.
